findings.what_was_wrong: Levon by Elton John has the release year 1071, about 880 years before the next earliest year in the column (1955), on a list of songs played on classic rock radio.
findings.right_value: Most likely 1971: one digit off, and every other Elton John song with a year in this table is from 1970 to 1975 (Tiny Dancer and Madman Across The Water are 1971). The table alone cannot prove the exact year.

findings.what_was_wrong: Bullfrog Blues by Rory Gallagher has the website name SONGFACTS.COM in its Release Year cell instead of a year, while its own Year? cell says 1 (a year was found) and F*G holds its play count, which the readme says is filled only when a year was found.
findings.right_value: unknown (the table has no other Rory Gallagher song or date to read it from)

other_excerpt_flags: Release Year is blank in 22 of the excerpt's 120 rows (Low). Honest: the folder readme says a blank Release Year means no SongFacts entry was found; on the full table the engine does not flag these blanks.
row_numbering: Row numbers are sheet rows: the header is row 1, so data row k (counting from 1) is sheet row k + 1. source_sheet_row is the same row in the full published file.
